shortlist_rationale: Activities are drawn only from the recommended cities (Phuket, Bangkok, Pattaya, Koh Phangan, Koh Phi Phi), so the two lists stay coherent for itinerary planning. City ranking blends ambient fit (60%) with the strength of each city's own activity lineup for this persona (40%) — so an activity-rich city (e.g. Bangkok for a couple) can earn a place even if the location itself scores only mid on ambient qualities; see city_score_0_10 vs activity_strength_0_10 on each city. Shortlist sized to trip need, not catalogue size: activities kept within 1.5 pts of the top score (min 6.5/10) and capped at 21 for 7 day(s) (~3/day); cities capped at 5. Fewer are returned when fewer genuinely fit the persona.
